description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for mocking API interactions, logging in via UI, and seeding authentication tokens for testing a dashboard web application. It sets up intercepts for various API endpoints related to users, reports, charts, and authentication, facilitating isolated and predictable testing environments.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercepts to mock API responses for authentication, user management, reports, charts, and other related features, enabling end-to-end tests without relying on real backend services.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Performs a simulated login through the application's login UI, then waits for the login API response, useful for tests that depend on authenticated sessions.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Directly sets a fake authentication token into localStorage to bypass UI login flows for testing purposes.
